findings.text: In the series '1 - x^2 + x^4 - x^6 + ...' every minus is a short, heavy bar, about 10 px wide at 960x540 against about 15 px for '+'. It looks like the Computer Modern text hyphen, not the math minus (TeX's minus has the same width as '+'). It is legible, but inconsistent beside the CM '+'. First seen at 17.967 s (f1078); on every later frame of that line in sheets 5-6. Crop: crops/s0006-slot5-series4x.png.

During the degree steps (01_3, about 30.6-31.5 s), the 'terms up to degree' counter switches to the next value at the start of each curve morph. Mid-morph stills therefore show a counter one step ahead of the curve: 8 with the degree-6 shape at 30.8 s (f1848), and 10 with the degree-8 shape at 31.4 s (f1884, sheet 8 slot 6). Each step lasts under a second and settles. Whether it reads as wrong in motion needs a motion review; this is only what the stills show.
